operations.summary: Read persisted control-plane backup run history
operations.description: Reads only signed start and terminal facts persisted by the controlled backup runner. A missing terminal or an unverifiable fact is returned as an unknown outcome and is never inferred from plans, approvals, or audit events. With no backup runner bound it answers an empty page with unconfigured=true; a partial or invalid binding is unavailable.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Signed continuation bound to the backup ID, state, and effective time range; omitted times retain the first page range.

fields.name: total_count
fields.description: All records matching the filters before cursor pagination.

fields.name: unconfigured
fields.description: True when no backup runner (manifest directory, source cluster and signing trust) is bound to this control plane; items is then empty because there is no backup target.
